message: I remember the first time we had a blackout. It was a cozy Sunday evening, and I thought I was ready — I had a flashlight, but I’d forgotten to check the batteries. So there I was, rummaging through drawers in the dark, tripping over the cat, and muttering to myself about how I should’ve stocked up on power banks and lanterns. We ended up playing charades by the glow of my phone, which, surprise surprise, ran out of juice halfway through! Lesson learned: it’s always good to be a little more prepared than I think I am. What’s your go-to for staying comfy in the dark?
